label: Bible Study
prompt: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my _____.
verse: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
note: The Last Supper, eaten at Passover — bread taken, blessed, broken, and given.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do _____ unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verse: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
note: Do good to everybody, Paul says — and especially to the household of faith.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the _____, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verse: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
note: Jesus overturned the moneychangers' tables in the temple — and the dove-sellers lost their seats too.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is _____ you.
verse: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
note: Asked when the kingdom would come, Jesus told the Pharisees to stop scanning the horizon for it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he shall be unto thee a _____ of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
verse: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.
note: The women of Bethlehem to once-bitter Naomi about her new grandson: 'a restorer of thy life' — and Ruth better than seven sons.
